桌面系统只挡入站，从不问你出站。NetworkControl 补上这一层：应用首:
Desktop systems only block inbound traffic and never ask about outbound. NetworkControl adds that layer: the first time an app goes online you get a prompt,
          and rules are precise down to domain, IP and port, with Windows, Linux and macOS sharing one rule model.

弹窗里没有层层选项，只有三个决定：动作、范围、时效。选完即生成一条规则，之后同类: The prompt has no nested options, just three decisions: action, scope, lifetime. Choose and a rule is created, so connections of the same kind stop bothering you.
允许或拒绝。默认焦点不落在「允许」上，弹窗出现后 1 秒内不响应点击与按键，打字: Allow or deny. Focus never lands on Allow by default, the prompt ignores clicks and key presses for 1 second after it appears, and pressing Enter while typing will not wave traffic through.

不打扰是设计目标。: Staying out of your way is the design goal.
同一应用的多个待决连接合并成一个弹窗（浏览器同时发起 20 个连接只弹一次），\:
Pending connections from the same app merge into one prompt (a browser opening 20 connections at once is asked only once),
          prompts for different apps queue up and are shown 1 at a time; anything waiting past the limit (30 seconds by default) is decided by the default action and marked "timed out".
          With do not disturb on, nothing prompts: the default policy applies directly and you review the outcome in the log.
从连接发起，到写入日志: From connection attempt to log entry
判决路径不涉及 I/O 与阻塞调用。签名校验、哈希计算、日志写入全部异步，结果缓: The decision path involves no I/O and no blocking calls. Signature checks, hashing and log writes are all asynchronous, with results cached.
引擎的过滤层看到每一条新的出站 TCP 连接与 UDP 流，覆盖 IPv4 与: The engine's filter layer sees every new outbound TCP connection and UDP flow, covering IPv4 and IPv6. Loopback, DHCP, system DNS, NTP and its own traffic take built-in allows.
PID → 完整路径 → 友好名称与图标 → 发布者或文件哈希。已签名应用按「签: PID → full path → friendly name and icon → publisher or file hash. Signed apps match on signer + path, unsigned ones on path + hash, so rules survive upgrades; if the hash changes, rules are paused and an alert fires.
规则以不可变快照参与匹配，读路径无锁。条件更具体的优先，同具体程度时拒绝优先，也: Rules match against an immutable snapshot, so the read path is lock-free. More specific conditions win, deny wins at equal specificity, and any rule can be pinned to the top by hand.
没有规则命中、且当前模式为询问时进入 PromptBroker：按应用合并、跨应: When no rule matches and the mode is ask, the connection goes to PromptBroker: merged per app, queued across apps, pausable countdown, and the default action applied and logged when no UI is present.
结果写入判决缓存与活动数据库，同时记下依据：命中了哪条规则、哪个模式、还是超时。: The result is written to the decision cache and the activity database with its grounds: which rule matched, which mode, or a timeout. Repeated identical connections are aggregated, so the log does not balloon.
三个平台的交互和规则模型保持一致，能力差异如实标注在界面上，不假装所有平台行为完: Interactions and the rule model stay the same on all three platforms, and capability gaps are labeled in the UI instead of pretending every platform behaves alike.

关于断网风险、域名准确性、平台差异和授权方式的直接回答。: Direct answers on the risk of cutting your network, domain accuracy, platform differences and how authorization works.
它会不会把我自己的网弄断？: Could it cut off my own network?
默认 fail-open：服务异常、崩溃或停止时放行流量。服务连续崩溃会自动降级:
The default is fail-open: traffic is allowed if the service errors, crashes or stops. Repeated crashes degrade to allow automatically; you can also choose fail-closed explicitly.
            Uninstall removes the filter, service and system extension, leaving no network interception behind. During the gap between boot and service start, each platform provides as much startup protection as it can.
为什么域名有时不准？: Why are domain names sometimes wrong?
拦截引擎本身不提供域名，靠 DNS 映射还原：Windows 用 ETW DNS:
The interception engine does not supply domain names itself; they are reconstructed from DNS mappings — ETW DNS events on Windows, DNS sniffing on Linux, the system extension on macOS.
            DoH and shared IPs both distort the mapping. So treat the domain in the UI as a hint, expand a row to see the real IP, and for connection-heavy apps like browsers just authorize "any connection from this app".
Windows 上「先阻断、再允许」是什么体验？: On Windows, what does "block first, allow after" feel like?
用户态 WFP 无法挂起连接等用户决定，所以首次连接会先被阻断，弹窗会明确提示「:
User-mode WFP cannot hold a connection while you decide, so the first connection is blocked and the prompt says so plainly: "this connection was blocked for now; allow it and the app can connect on retry".
            A few apps do not retry after the first failure — authorize in the prompt or switch to disable filtering for a moment. A later version adds the driver engine for true hold-and-decide.
升级软件后，规则会失效吗？: Do rules break when an app updates?
不会。有签名的应用按「签名者 + 路径」匹配，没签名的按「路径 + 哈希」匹配。:
No. Signed apps match on signer + path, unsigned ones on path + hash. If an unsigned app's hash changes, or a signed app's signer changes,
            the app's existing rules are paused and a "program changed" alert fires instead of quietly reusing the old authorization.
支持多用户和远程桌面吗？: Does it support multiple users and remote desktop?
询问弹窗只出现在发起连接的用户会话中；系统账户发起的连接，询问显示给管理员。没有:
Prompts appear only in the session that started the connection; connections started by system accounts prompt the administrator. With no user logged in, connections are decided by the default action and logged while
            the service keeps running. Whether multi-user scenarios make v1.0 is still under review.
